correctness.rationale: The standalone checker reconstructs the full 32x256 exact-subsequence incidence matrix, validates six exact nonnegative rational dual inequalities with slopes/intercepts, and verifies explicit witnesses attaining their floored lower envelope for every 1<=L<=93. L=0 and L>=93 follow exactly from the row-incidence count 93. Therefore one finite theorem holds for all integral list allowances without reliance on optimization logs.
